name: French independent career coach supporting ten clients

context.geography: France, clients in several French regions
constraints: Clients include career changers and returners
Different goals and experience per client
Needs client autonomy and clear privacy boundaries
Cannot assume shared accounts or access to private applications
context.company_awareness: Knows recurring employers but each client's target list differs.

trigger: Three clients arrive at sessions with scattered links and inconsistent searches, consuming time intended for career decisions and interview preparation.

searches_run.query: outil suivi recherche emploi clients coach carrière
searches_run.observation: Retrieval included coach-targeted commercial platforms and candidate-focused tracking resources. Direct JobWinner inspection advertised organizational branding and client application monitoring—capabilities distinct from a personal tracker.

searches_run.query: partager liste offres emploi accompagnement reconversion clients alertes
searches_run.observation: Results mixed coaching tools, jobseekers' guidance and France Travail employer/candidate pages. The inspected France Travail article describes personal contact/application organization; it does not establish coach access or shared-list functionality.

sources.title: Outils d'IA pour les coachs de carrière | JobWinner
sources.supports: Directly inspected vendor page markets white-label coaching tools and client monitoring; feature and outcome claims were not tested.

sources.title: Myjob-booster : gérer vos candidatures et vos contacts | France Travail
sources.supports: Direct article describes candidate-side organization of contacts, tasks, meetings and applications; not a multi-client coaching dashboard.

sources.title: Hatch | Coach de carrière personnel
sources.supports: Retrieved vendor description targets advisers and client progress workflows, demonstrating an organizational-tool alternative.

best_entry_page.primary_query: aider un client à cibler des entreprises recherche emploi
best_entry_page.promise: A French guide coaches can use to help each client select covered employers, refine role searches and create their own alerts.
best_entry_page.cta: Explore the free search with a client, then let them create and control their own saved searches.
proof_needed: French-language onboarding understandable to nontechnical clients
Examples of broader transferable-skill searches without automatic eligibility claims
Exact free-plan limits and covered employers
Verify any link-sharing functionality before presenting shared lists
Clearly distinguish individual tracker use from coach access and client management

conversion_objections: Ten saved searches is not a ten-client management plan.
I need boundaries between clients' records.
Can clients understand the tool without ongoing help?
Career changers may miss opportunities if filters use only former job titles.
Can I refer a client without implying I can see their private progress?

avoid_targeting.query: logiciel gestion multi clients coach carrière
avoid_targeting.reason: No multi-client dashboard or organizational permissions demonstrated.
Recruiter ATS intent exceeds candidate-side product.
White-label and commercial client-management capabilities are unverified.

message_to_founder: Simulation: Je peux recommander un outil simple que mes clients gardent en main, surtout pour choisir des entreprises et recevoir leurs propres alertes. Ne présentez pas dix recherches sauvegardées comme un espace pour dix clients : j'aurais alors besoin de permissions, de séparation des dossiers et de fonctions de suivi que vous n'avez pas démontrées.
